bucket.reason: random-normalized route + same-split science variants + jackknife stable; final confirmation still requires curl and bootstrap gates

dashboard_v31.claim_policy: v31 fixes P30 curl diagnostic population and keeps route/global confirmation separated; P36/P41/P33/P32 require object/table/measurement/strain products.

bucket.note: v31 fixes curl diagnostic population from v29 variant_results; final route confirm requires curl and bootstrap gates.

curl.pass_rule: curl_abs_delta / median_abs_science_delta < 0.60 AND 0.05 < curl_density_shuffle_p_high < 0.95 under the same SDSS random-normalized split

dashboard_v32.claim_policy: v32 adds curl-remediation diagnostics. P30-SDSS can only promote route-specifically; global P30 still requires a second repaired route.

dashboard_v33.claim_policy: v33 separates P30 curl-clean core-family diagnostics from publication confirmation. Curl-contaminated routes remain near-confirm only.

dashboard_v34.claim_policy: v34 only allows P30-SDSS-core route confirmation if curl-projected residual, residual-curl null, paired bootstrap, and patch jackknife pass. Global P30 remains blocked.

core_projection.claim_scope: P30-SDSS-core only; global P30 still requires an independent route.

dashboard_v35.claim_policy: v35 fixes P30 curl-projection execution: low-Nside sequential sampling, residual JSON on every path, route-specific promotion only. Global P30 remains blocked.

projection.claim_scope: P30-SDSS-core only; global P30 still requires an independent route.

dashboard_v36.claim_policy: v36 blocks P30 route promotion unless projection raw deltas reproduce the canonical same-split route before residual projection. Global P30 remains blocked.

consistency.action_if_failed: Abort claim-level P30 residual interpretation; audit split labels, map sign convention, coordinate order, pixelization, and variant file mapping.
consistency.purpose: Do not interpret curl-projected residuals unless pre-projection raw deltas reproduce the canonical same-split route.

dashboard_v37.claim_policy: v37 repairs the split manifest and forces P30 projection/residual tests to reuse canonical labels and reproduce v29 raw deltas before route promotion.

consistency.claim_policy: If false, residual projection is not physics evidence and cannot promote P30.

split_manifest.claim_scope: mandatory diagnostic manifest; projection cannot be used if unavailable
split_manifest.manifest_policy: Projection samplers must load these labels; they must not recompute high/low labels internally.
split_manifest.required_consistency: projection raw deltas must match canonical same-split raw deltas before residual tests are claim-usable

dashboard_v38.claim_policy: v38 audits row/order/label/pixelfunc mismatch. Projection remains disabled until canonical raw deltas reproduce v29/v34; the positive P30-SDSS random-normalized route is preserved separately but not promoted.

inversion_test.claim_policy: If suspected, projection must test label ordering and H/L mask application before any residual fit is attempted.

positive_route_preserved.claim_level: route-specific positive candidate; not projection-confirmed and not global P30

projection_guard.policy: Residual projection is not computed/used for claims until canonical raw deltas reproduce v29/v34. Preserve P30-SDSS random-normalized positive route separately.

dashboard_v39.claim_policy: v39 fixes/tests P30 projection H/L orientation. P30 can only promote route-specifically if raw deltas reproduce canonical positives and residual curl projection passes.

fixed_projection.claim_policy: May only promote P30-SDSS-core if raw deltas reproduce canonical route after orientation fix and residual gates pass; global P30 still blocked.
fixed_projection.claim_scope: P30-SDSS-core route only; global P30 still requires an independent route.
fixed_projection.precondition: raw delta consistency must pass after v39 H/L orientation fix

label_fix.claim_policy: If orientation_fix is inverted, the projection sampler must swap H/L masks internally but report both signs. If raw consistency still fails, residual projection is disabled.

label_fix.policy: Projection must consume p30_canonical_split_manifest_v37 rows only and compute both H-L and L-H.

positive_route_preserved.claim_level: route-specific positive candidate; not projection-confirmed and not global P30

dashboard_v40.claim_policy: v40 can promote only P30-SDSS-core route if orientation-fixed raw deltas, patch-level science-vs-curl bootstrap, residual curl-null, and family-specific residual gates pass. Global P30 remains blocked.

curl_residual_separation.cache_policy: Cache sampled ACT values in .ccdr_round10_cache/p30_v40_sampled_*; do not cache huge maps in the bundle.
curl_residual_separation.claim_policy: Only P30-SDSS-core may promote; global P30 still needs an independent route. If v40 fails, preserve positive route as candidate only.
curl_residual_separation.claim_scope: P30-SDSS-core route only; global P30 remains blocked until a second independent route passes.

curl_family_specificity.quarantine_policy: If one variant drives curl coupling, quarantine it; need >=2 core variants with residual significant positive for route promotion.

patch_level_gate_v40.rule: patch-level residual science-minus-abs-curl CI16 > 0 with >=4 usable patches

curl_residual_separation.purpose: Separate science signal from curl leakage using manifest-aligned samples and patch-level bootstrap.

gate.claim_scope: P30-SDSS-core route only; global P30 remains separate.
